scope_note: Major-family high-impact adjudication now covers every family in the current model parameter registry. Exact Python/JSON static-site adjudication remains incremental and is tracked separately by the generated inventory.

findings.current_value_function: piecewise-linear current/future/liquidity/resilience curve over Simulator competitive-strength percentile
findings.provenance: legacy GM objective-weight anchors preserved as a governed prior; artifact explicitly says empirically_validated=false
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Independent historical strategy-outcome target with temporal holdout; compare current prior, neutral baseline, current/future-only model, regularized continuous curve, and hierarchical state-dependent curve if sample supports it.

findings.provenance: legacy GM state boundaries; continuous AUTO economics do not step at these boundaries
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Test whether discrete labels are needed at all; preserve continuous AUTO curve and eliminate threshold economic authority if explicit posture semantics can be defined without arbitrary state boundaries.

findings.provenance: hand-set legacy strategic adjustment
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Independent target plus ablation proving incremental value beyond competitive strength and future-value component; eliminate if unidentified.

findings.provenance: legacy hand-set title-probability adjustment; explicitly suppressed during normal Simulator-derived competitive-state resolution to avoid double counting
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Determine whether degraded-runtime strategic weighting should use a simpler neutral fallback rather than an additional title coefficient.

findings.provenance: bounded expert policy constraints
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Use learned uncertainty bands and monotonic constraints to determine whether hard bounds are still necessary; retain broad safety bounds until evidence supports narrowing.

downstream_consumers: candidate discovery before GM3/Trade Decision evaluation
findings.provenance: governed uncertainty set around legacy package discount curve; explicitly marked economic_coefficients_fitted=false
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Frozen contemporaneous package values and held-out transaction/search-recall evidence. Until then preserve multiple curves as uncertainty rather than selecting one as truth.

downstream_consumers: Monte Carlo precision of expected wins/playoff/bye/title estimates
findings.provenance: runtime precision choice documented in application architecture and simulator implementation
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Empirically measure convergence/error versus simulation count; tune computational budget without treating it as franchise economics.

findings.current_value_function: unweighted median of league-relative expected points, wins, playoff probability, and net championship-equity deltas
findings.provenance: structural de-duplication choice: correlated Simulator outcomes are combined by median specifically to avoid assigning hand-set exchange weights
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Compare median aggregation with simpler single-outcome and robust alternatives on temporal historical decision outcomes; do not add correlated current-outcome weights without incremental evidence.

findings.current_value_function: baseline_team_market_redraft_value; transaction redraft exposure fallback; unit fallback only when no redraft evidence
findings.provenance: observed focal roster market-redraft scale replaces prior fixed hand-set current/future conversion constants
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Validate redraft-scale stability and fallback frequency over frozen historical snapshots; challenge only with a simpler data-derived scale that improves held-out decision calibration.

findings.provenance: hand-set additive smoothing for leave-one-manager-out position opportunity shares
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Time-ordered manager-action prediction versus unsmoothed and data-derived smoothing baselines; preserve zero franchise-utility authority unless incremental predictive value is established.

findings.provenance: hand-set lower bound on how strongly roster need can suppress expected acquisition share
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Held-out action-choice likelihood/ranking with shrinkage; eliminate the floor if observed need/opportunity terms identify behavior without it.

findings.provenance: hand-set blend with no independent validation identified
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Prefer exposing need and surplus separately. Any combined redundancy score should require held-out predictive evidence before receiving authority.

findings.runtime_authority: PRESCREEN_CUT_ORDERING; CAN_RETAIN FINAL AUTHORITY IN LARGE_OR_NON_FOCAL_PLAN_SPACES
downstream_consumers: GM3/Trade Decision utility through selected cut plan
findings.provenance: legacy hand-set retention-cost ordering retained as search acceleration/fallback; tractable final focal plans are re-evaluated through canonical downstream Trade Score
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Prefer canonical downstream utility to select among legal cut plans. Expand exact/top-k enumeration until retention-cost formula is search-only; if a prescreen remains, estimate recall against exact cut-plan winners rather than fitting intuitive multipliers.

findings.provenance: runtime shortlist budget for exposing low-retention-cost alternatives; does not itself assign economic value
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Benchmark top-k recall against exact canonical cut-plan winners across representative rosters; choose smallest budget that meets a documented recall/convergence target.

findings.provenance: governance/architecture de-duplication: canonical focal Shared Decision Utility remains ranking authority; acceptance and behavioral evidence are diagnostic rather than assigned arbitrary exchange rates
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: None for zero incremental acceptance/behavior authority. Any future positive exchange weight would require independent evidence plus architecture review and exact provenance registration.

findings.parameter_name: bilateral and focal utility sign boundary
findings.provenance: zero is the semantic indifference point of the canonical utility delta, not a fitted acceptance threshold
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Validate uncertainty around utilities and near-zero stability. Do not move the zero boundary merely to create more intuitive deals.

findings.parameter_name: Simulator percentile interpolation across external early/mid/late pick cells
findings.current_value_function: piecewise linear early→mid for percentile <=0.5 and mid→late for percentile >0.5
findings.provenance: canonical Simulator competitive percentile supplies continuous original-owner quality coordinate; observed external early/mid/late market cells supply value anchors; legacy categorical valuation cliff removed
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Frozen preseason owner-state cohorts versus realized draft slots across horizons; validate percentile persistence and interval coverage before claiming calibrated slot probabilities.

findings.parameter_name: Stats Guy to active market scale normalization
findings.current_value_function: median FantasyCalc/Stats Guy ratio over overlapping player values
findings.provenance: data-derived median scale normalization across contemporaneous overlapping player values; no manually selected conversion coefficient
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Track overlap count, ratio dispersion, temporal stability, and alternative robust scales; replace only if held-out/current cross-source calibration improves.

findings.provenance: three seasons of realized NFL weekly FSFFL scoring outcomes; useful volatility proxy but not conditional forecast-error residuals
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Forecast residual distributions by position/horizon with expanding-window holdouts; compare 1/2/3+ season windows and coverage rather than assuming three seasons.

findings.provenance: hand-set position-specific lower bounds; no independent forecast-residual validation identified
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Estimate forecast-error floor/heteroskedastic variance by position and mean projection using temporal residuals; shrink sparse groups.

findings.provenance: hand-set robustification/bounds around realized weekly scoring dispersion
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Compare robust variance estimators and clipping domains on temporal forecast residual coverage; retain bounds only as broad numerical safety constraints if not identified.

findings.provenance: hand-set sample-size shrinkage rule; concept is statistically defensible but constants are not estimated
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Estimate player/position variance components with hierarchical or empirical-Bayes shrinkage on temporally held-out forecast residuals rather than choosing n/32 and a 75% cap.

findings.current_value_function: Normal(mean, sd) with fixed z=±0.67448975 for p25/p75
findings.provenance: simple parametric distribution assumption; quartile z values are mathematically rule-defined conditional on Normality, but Normality itself is unvalidated
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Compare Normal, truncated/mixture, empirical residual and monotone quantile approaches on held-out interval coverage, PIT/calibration, tails and zero/availability mass.

findings.runtime_authority: NON_AUTHORITATIVE_IN_CANONICAL_SIMULATOR_PATH; PAYLOAD/DIAGNOSTIC FIELD ONLY UNLESS ANOTHER CONSUMER IS EXPLICITLY GOVERNED
findings.provenance: fixed 8% SD offset with no evidentiary source identified; canonical Simulator does not consume this field, and the offset is inconsistent with the declared symmetric Normal distribution if interpreted as its median
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Canonical Simulator traces use mean, sd and active_probability only. Remove the arbitrary median offset from authoritative semantics; if a median is needed for presentation, derive it consistently from the governed distribution or estimate it empirically.

findings.current_value_function: 0.0 on bye; 1.0 on every non-bye week
downstream_consumers: Simulator lineup substitution and weekly scoring
findings.provenance: known simplification explicitly disclosed by weekly projection audit: no injury/availability adjustment beyond byes
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Estimate non-bye active/start probability using historical weekly availability with position/age/status/horizon features where timestamp-safe; use hierarchical base rates when specific injury information is unavailable.

downstream_consumers: choice of player-specific versus position volatility
findings.provenance: hand-set sample sufficiency thresholds; primarily governance/runtime stability rather than direct economic coefficients
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Use stability/coverage curves to justify minimum sample thresholds; hierarchical models may eliminate hard player/position cutoffs.

findings.provenance: code comment explicitly describes a mild conservative shared offensive-environment loading pending richer calibration; no residual-correlation fit identified
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Estimate same-team forecast-residual covariance/correlation by position pair and horizon using frozen forecasts. Until then retain bounded loadings as an explicitly unvalidated prior; do not substitute raw score correlation for residual correlation without qualification.

findings.provenance: hand-set scarce-slot-first ordering intended to reduce bad fallback collisions; it is algorithmic rather than an explicit valuation premium
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Replace greedy slot ordering with exact legal backup assignment per simulation state when computationally tractable, or prove equivalence/near-equivalence across exhaustive synthetic shortage cases. Do not calibrate slot-order integers as economics.

findings.provenance: hand-set numerical/sanity bounds around optional opponent adjustment source; absence or invalid source is neutral
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Validate opponent adjustment residual lift and cap exceedance on temporal weekly forecasts before narrowing or expanding bounds; keep neutral behavior when evidence absent.

findings.current_value_function: Razzball QB/RB/WR/TE season stat projections recalculated under actual FSFFL scoring; FantasyPros preseason ECR used for mapping/QC rather than a fitted numerical blend
findings.provenance: contemporaneous external Razzball season projection tables with source last-updated labels; mapped to Sleeper and rescored under league rules
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Compare frozen contemporaneous external source(s), the native challenger and simple persistence/consensus baselines by position/horizon on expanding-window holdouts. Promote a source/ensemble only on held-out improvement and calibration.

findings.runtime_authority: DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT; INCREMENTAL ACCEPTANCE SHIFT DISABLED AND REGISTRY STATES INCREMENTAL FINAL VALUE DISABLED
findings.provenance: hand-set bounded pair-insurance diagnostic retained after structural de-duplication against canonical lineup/replacement resilience
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Do not calibrate while diagnostic-only. Reintroduction requires incremental held-out or Simulator evidence beyond roster-specific replacement resilience.

findings.provenance: heuristic plausibility bands retained for interpretation; no accepted/rejected offer denominator exists and canonical ranking gives acceptance zero exchange weight
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Collect rejected/expired offers or defensible choice opportunities and validate probabilities/bands time-ordered; until then avoid probability language and do not use bands as economic gates.

findings.parameter_name: market-distance simulation priority and diversified shortlist
findings.current_value_function: coefficient-free market-distance search ordering; downstream canonical simulation/utility controls quality
downstream_consumers: candidate recall before final Trade Decision evaluation
findings.provenance: current market values provide distance coordinate; prior arbitrary cross-signal prescreen coefficients/band eligibility gates removed
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Measure recall of eventual canonical winners as search budget varies; treat shortlist size as compute budget, not valuation coefficient.

findings.current_value_function: all nonnegative with at least one positive => accept_pareto_improvement; all nonpositive with at least one negative => reject_pareto_deterioration; mixed => needs_context
findings.provenance: legacy numeric championship/value thresholds removed; classifier now reflects dominance direction and delegates mixed tradeoffs to canonical utility
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: None for dominance semantics; mixed cases remain governed by Shared Decision Utility.

findings.current_value_function: Shared Decision Utility with canonical Simulator/market primitives; no separate Team Improvement ranking coefficient or categorical guardrail
findings.provenance: fixed unit scales and duplicate application-specific ranking coefficients removed; application consumes governed shared primitives
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Temporal decision/outcome validation belongs to Shared Decision Utility and its inputs; do not create Team Improvement-specific compensating weights.

findings.current_value_function: zero incremental market-tier scarcity authority; roster-specific replacement sensitivity remains active through legal lineup reoptimization
findings.provenance: same-source market scarcity repricing structurally removed because market values already embed scarcity; roster-specific removal/reoptimization measures actual lineup opportunity cost
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Validate replacement-loss magnitudes and injury/availability scenarios; do not introduce position multipliers unless residual evidence remains after Simulator/market/replacement mechanisms.

findings.current_value_function: governed counterfactual orchestration using shared mechanics; full historical Alternate History application is not current production on main
findings.provenance: registry paths corrected from nonexistent legacy alternate_history files to current counterfactual application/runner paths
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Preserve functionality with explicit modeled-inference labels; calibrate only observable branch probabilities and never imply the not-yet-production historical Alternate History application exists.

findings.parameter_name: league scoring, lineup, roster, draft and playoff configuration
findings.current_value_function: Sleeper-synced rule values normalized through governed league-rule helpers
findings.provenance: league configuration and standard Sleeper rule semantics, not fitted coefficients
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Maintain portability tests for alternate league formats and verify external semantics before supporting undocumented/nonstandard rules.

findings.current_value_function: inactive; market rank remains descriptive and multiplier is neutral
findings.provenance: former hand-set FantasyCalc rank-tier premium/discount structurally removed because it repriced the same external market anchor using its own rank
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Keep inactive. Reintroduce only a versioned residual model that improves future outcomes/value beyond the contemporaneous market anchor.

findings.current_value_function: zero incremental valuation adjustment; proposed adjustment retained diagnostically
findings.provenance: FantasyCalc 30-day trend comes from the same source as current FantasyCalc value; governed override removes incremental repricing to prevent same-source signal reuse
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Test whether trend predicts future FSFFL-relevant value/outcomes after conditioning on current market value; keep zero incremental authority unless held-out residual lift is stable.

findings.current_value_function: legacy calculations preserved for diagnostics/reproducibility but governed overrides remove independent current market-value authority
findings.provenance: historical hand-set multipliers; governance audit confirms owner-specific and football-market repricing is disabled in current authoritative path
findings.evidence_needed_for_further_promotion: Do not recalibrate as a bundle. Any individual signal must demonstrate time-ordered incremental value beyond its canonical owner before reintroduction.
